mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `book` (title, isbn, author_id, publication_date, page_count, genre_id) VALUES ( #{title}, #{isbn}, #{author.id}, #{publicationDate}, #{pageCount}, #{genre.id} )
mapper.sql: b.id, b.title, b.isbn, b.publication_date, b.page_count, b.genre_id, a.id AS author_id, a.name AS author_name
mapper.select:
SELECT

mapper.update: UPDATE `book` SET title=#{title}, isbn=#{isbn}, author_id=#{author.id}, publication_date=#{publicationDate}, page_count=#{pageCount}, genre_id=#{genre.id} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.isbn, b.publication_date, b.page_count, b.genre_id, a.id AS author_id, a.name AS author_name, r.id AS review_id, r.comment, r.rating FROM `book` b LEFT JOIN author a ON b.author_id = a.id LEFT JOIN review r ON b.id = r.book_id WHERE b.id = #{id}
